record.label: Absolute error on the fixed-point input grid
record.statement: The 25-bit approximation has absolute error at most $1.25\times10^{-7}$ for every representable input in $[-1,1]$.
record.boundary: The input grid contains all $16{,}777{,}217$ multiples of $2^{-23}$ in $[-1,1]$, including both endpoints. The error bound applies to the increment $z(y)$ added to the output register.
